facts.fact: In the President's statement the President of the United Republic of Tanzania says 'I unveil' the Digital Economy Strategic Framework 2024-2034 as one of the key pillars of Digital Transformation; the passages name no cabinet or parliamentary act and give no day, so the document's publication year is used.

The framework's title and the President's statement give its period as 2024-2034, which had not ended in 2024; the document is the text, published by the Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology on ictc.go.tz. Text public: yes
